effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 [Airu Suzaki], [Ren Tobari] or [Ryoma Mogami] among them without paying the cost. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞. Then, place 1 Digimon card with ＜Save＞ in its text from your trash under 1 of your Tamers.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has ＜Save＞ in its text, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
